snippet.title: Passionstruck - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
In a miraculous country known as the Isles, its people wait with bated breath for their savior to come along... and this time, it might just be you!

Available Dec 7th on itch.io! 
https://im-pika-chan.itch.io/passionstruck

Battle music by Noirnova: https://x.com/NoirNovaVII
Art, trailer, and game by Alice "Pika Chan": https://impikachan.carrd.co/
